## Verdict: clean - `merge-ready`

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes the stock simulation (the field engine of `Stock`). I found no blocker.

The PR is a draft. The author flags it ready. I did not change the draft state.

## Where it was built

Local build on host `egg`, in a worktree. Trial merge of head `6954260e9` with upstream/main `afca9b8b1`: clean, no conflicts. All tests below ran on the trial merge.

## What I checked in the code

- `subtract_batch_fitted` and `subtract_batch` share one body (`subtract_moves`). Only the `fit` flag differs. `subtract_batch` and `subtract` keep the refusal of #4079.
- A refusal from `fit` occurs before any write to the field. The field stays as it was ("Set only past every gate").
- The chord split uses equal fractions of the two ends, and the last piece ends exactly at `b`. A straight chord with one tool axis sweeps the same solid in pieces as in one piece.
- `ArcPiece::split` uses the same construction as `arc_sweeps` (`b0`, `span`, linear Z, `sag = rad * (1 - cos(step/2))`, `p0`/`p1` from `anchor`). The last piece ends exactly at `z1`.
- The doubling and bisection: `most` stops the doubling, and the refusal at `hi >= most` is a named error. When the bisection is not monotone, the result still falls under the ceiling, as the decision file says.
- A sweep past the ceiling with no chord ends and no arc piece refuses by name. It is never cut as nothing.
- The `bounded` flag is now set for each piece. That is the same result as for the whole sweep.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the new library code. `field_cut.rs` is 388 lines, under the 400-line rule. The decision file `docs/decisions/4179-segment-to-ceiling.md` is present. No process file, UI, post or recorded program (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, catalog) changed. No goldens moved. No new crate dependency.

## Build and tests

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | green: 85 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (16.0 min) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | green: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (10.8 min) |
| `field_wide_tool` (debug), the six pins | 6 passed, 1 ignored |
| `a_127_mm_tools_helical_entry_cuts_on_both_engines` (release, `--ignored`, by hand) | passed, 314.5 s |

Extra suites run: none were owed. The diff does not change `testdata/` or a fixture directory, and it does not touch the import code. No example catalog suite was owed: no post, operation, motion or catalog file changed.

Heavy lanes: not run. `camcraft-sim` is not one of the heavy crates (`kernel`, `motion`, `app`). This is a `P3` PR, so it needs no heavy step. I ran the one ignored pin of this PR by hand (see above).

## Mutations (run on the trial merge, then reverted)

1. `subtract_batch_fitted` calls `subtract_moves(.., false)`, so it refuses as main does. Result: RED. 5 of 6 pins fail (all except the short-move pin, which does not need a split). This confirms the pins fail on main's behaviour.
2. The chord pieces cover only the first half of the chord (`t = 0.5 * j / k`, last end not `b`). This is a silent under-cut. Result: RED. 3 pins fail: `a_wide_tools_long_chord_still_refuses_and_its_segments_cut`, `the_single_move_stock_arms_cut_the_long_chord` and `an_undercut_discs_6_mm_plunge_cuts_through_simulate_undercut`. Two pins stay green (see item 2 below).

## Optional, non-blocking (follow-ups, file after merge)

1. **No cap on the piece count** (`field_cut.rs`, `fit`). `most` is clamped only to `u32::MAX`. `arc_sweeps` caps its pieces at `1e6`. A move with an absurd travel and a long path in the field can make `pieces(k)` allocate a very large `Vec` before it refuses. Before this PR, the same move was refused by name. A real program does not reach this. A cap with a named refusal (for example the `1e6` of `arc_sweeps`) closes the class. Suggested: `P7`.
2. **Two pins probe only the first half of the move.** `an_endmills_300_mm_pass_cuts_on_both_engines` probes at x 170 (the middle of 20..320). `a_127_mm_tools_6_mm_plunge_cuts_on_both_engines` probes at z 27 (the middle of 30..24). Mutation 2 left both green. A probe near the end of each move (for example x 300, and z 24.5 inside the tool) makes each pin catch a short cut by itself. Suggested: `P7`.
3. **The arc-split pin runs in no gate.** The helix pin is `#[ignore]`d in `crates/sim`. `HEAVY_CRATES` in `xtask/src/plan.rs` does not include `sim`, so the release tier does not run it. Other `heavy lane` tests in `crates/sim` have the same gap, so this is not new with this PR. A small arc pin in the default suite, or a light twin, gives `ArcPiece::split` gate coverage. Suggested: `P7`.

## Laws

- Prime Directive: refusals are named errors, and nothing panics. Item 1 above is the one degenerate-input note.
- Tests live with the code (`crates/sim/tests/field_wide_tool.rs`, an existing binary). The slow pin is in the heavy lane, with its reason.
- The body has the changelog line, the pinning tests, what was not exercised, and `Fixes #4179`.
